player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Chay movimientoqa [macro micro] nisqa formapi kanan tiyan, chaypin 0-8 nisqakuna kashan.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: The micro_board, row, or col is out of range.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: The player must play in the next micro board.

game_action.played: Pukllaq {player_id} pukllarqan micro p'ukllana {macro_idx}pi, selula {micro_idx}ni (pura {row}, k'uska {col}). Pukllaq {opponent_id}manaraq pukllanayqan {nxt_txt}pi.

outcome.win: Player {player_id} wins Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
